ranking_method: Rank by water level at City Locks in NGVD29. Pre-1957 values measured near Mayo's Bridge are lowered 1.3 ft to estimate the Locks level (1936 and 1969 both show a 1.3 to 1.4 ft drop over that 0.9 mi). 1816 and 1987 have no Locks value and are unranked. 2010 is placed by its NWS value with its datum unresolved.
